chapter_title: Concerning the Five Things that he constructed wit
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:** The Divine operative power established five fundamental structures of spiritual order, drawing them from the pathways of living truth and the firm outermost containments of wisdom within [GAP-1: the most resistant ultimate natural forms].

**¶2:** The first is the complete foundational plane of sustaining truth that rests upon the power of the Divine upholding principle — that which bears the whole weight of the spiritual cosmos.

**¶3:** The second are the spanning and connecting truths of [GAP-2: the] great supporting doctrine of order that stands before that sustaining power, bridging what is above to what is below.

**¶4:** The third is the determining boundary-structure that gives fixed form to the hells — the ordering constraint by which evil and falsity are held within definite limits and cannot spread beyond them.

**¶5:** The fourth are the [GAP-3: complete and holy] sustaining truths that have been established throughout the vast general expanse of natural knowledge, in [GAP-4: the] full extension of all ordered spiritual states throughout the universe of the mind.

**¶6:** The fifth are the doctrinal truths extending in every direction — the four quarters of spiritual space — that encompass and protect the receptacles of good and truth, so that what is received from the Divine may be contained and not dispersed.

---
*Note:* The overall architecture describes how Divine power operating through truth constructs the entire framework of the regenerate mind: its sustaining ground, its connecting doctrines, its containment of evils, its universal supporting principles, and its protective boundaries around every receiving vessel of the will and understanding.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The Living Spirit constructed five great things from veins and skull[s in the] hard [bodies].
The first is the disc that is placed upon [the sh]oulder of the Porter.
The se[con]d are the arches of [the] pillar that is before him.
[The th]ird is the [mou]ld of the fo[r]m for the gehennas.
The fourth are the [seven] pillars that he has erected in the great sea, in [the] seven parts of the universe.
The fifth are the four walls that surround the vessels.

fills.explanation: In Manichaean cosmogony the Living Spirit constructs cosmic structures from the hard bodies of the defeated archons, which correspond to "the most resistant ultimate natural forms" — the outermost material substrate; "bodies" is the correct natural-plane term.

The spiritual reading confirms the definite article ("the great supporting doctrine of order"), and Coptic syntax requires the article before "pillar" here as a known, specific cosmological structure.

The spiritual reading gives "complete and holy" sustaining truths, and seven in correspondences signifies what is complete and holy; moreover the same verse specifies "seven parts of the universe," confirming the pillars are seven in number.

The spiritual reading confirms the definite article ("in the full extension of all ordered spiritual states"), and the phrase "the seven parts of the universe" requires the article to designate the known cosmic divisions.
